articles.summary: With EI Mobile App version 5.4.5, installers now have access to an improved commissioning experience built around real-time active commissioning — a streamlined workflow that guides users through each required step, confirms completed actions, and helps identify issues as they happen.
articles.title: Software Update: May 2026 with Real-Time Active Commissioning
